chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 68h online + 3h offline + 1h Final exam + 78 self-study
chung.Description:
The course "History of Design" explores the formation and evolution of design through various historical periods, from the Stone Age to contemporary movements. Situated at the intersection of art and science, the course provides students with a deep understanding of shifts in style, technology, and aesthetic perspectives over time, fostering an awareness of the cultural and social values that shape design.
The course aims to equip students with foundational knowledge of the history and progression of design schools, while encouraging analytical and critical thinking within a historical context. Consequently, students can leverage these historical insights to identify, evaluate, and apply appropriate design elements to their future projects.
chung.StudentTasks:
1. Join the online course(s) when being invited by the admin.
2. Enroll in the courses, regularly study the course at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assignments... as required
3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct
4. Keep up with online learning progress (bonus will be awarded)
5. Communicate and discuss in forum
6. Attend offline sessions in the Campus (Optional)
7. Must complete the course(s) with certification(s) in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
chung.Note:
1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.
2) Theoretical Exam (TE)
3) Final Result (FR) = min (10, TE + Bonus)
4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5

clo: (Basic knowledge) Summarize the development process of Design history; Identify and describe the main stakes concerned wwith design styles and movements.

(Research skills) Understand the contexts of the main styles and movements in Design history, which related to important inventions in manufactures, significant events on the market, talented and pioneering designers.
(Critical thinking). Analyze and evaluate critically the records of the past in Design History.
(Communication skills) Study optional cases in Design history, organize and express the individual thoughts clearly and coherently both in orally (presentations) and writing (assignments/essays)
